definitions.explanation: A company that manages residential or commercial properties on behalf of the owner. Handles maintenance, tenant relations, rent collection, and building upkeep.

examples.japanese: {管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}に{電話|でんわ}する。
{水漏|みずも}れがあったので{管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}した。
examples.english: I contacted the management company because there was a water leak.

examples.japanese: マンションの{管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}が{変|か}わって、サービスが{良|よ}くなった。
examples.english: The apartment building's management company changed, and the service improved.

notes:
A compound of {管理|かんり} (management) and {会社|がいしゃ} (company). In the context of Japanese housing, the {管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ} is the first point of contact for tenants when something goes wrong — from broken appliances to noise complaints.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}する: to contact the management company
- {管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}に{相談|そうだん}する: to consult the management company
- {管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}の{担当者|たんとうしゃ}: management company representative
- マンションの{管理|かんり}{会社|がいしゃ}: apartment building management company

RELATED WORDS:
- {大家|おおや}: landlord — the property owner (may hire a management company)
- {管理人|かんりにん}: building manager/superintendent — the person who is physically present at the building
- {不動産|ふどうさん}{会社|がいしゃ}: real estate company — handles buying, selling, and renting
